info.name: Vectorization Service API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the vectorization service, one request per scenario, each with a saved example response.

**Variables** (collection level, override them in an environment):
- `baseUrl`: `http://localhost:8000` locally. Other environments serve the API under `/vector`, e.g. `https://<host>/vector`.
- `sourceId`, `companyId`, `theme`: the sample document used across folders.

**Files**: upload, update and upsert requests have an empty `file` field. Choose a file in Postman; each request's description says which kind.

**Examples**: captured from a live run against a fresh collection, in this order: uploads, search and utilities, update, upsert, metadata, theme, delete. Run them in that order to get the same responses. Examples marked *illustrative* cover failures that can't be reproduced on demand (Qdrant or Redis outages, timeouts, very large files). Their bodies use the service's real message text.

**Known issues** (current behavior, shown as-is):
- Search: `top_k` <= 0 with a query returns a plain-text 500, not 422. Without a query, a negative `top_k` returns all documents except the last |top_k|.
- Text search: `top_k` <= 0 returns a plain-text 500.
- Upload: a CSV without `SL NO` or a PDF with no text returns 500 with the 400 message inside.
- PUT / upsert: invalid `metadata` JSON is silently ignored (POST returns 400).
- `POST /api/query/`: every valid request returns 500.
- `GET /api/health`: 503 whenever `REDIS_CACHE_ENABLED=false`, even when Qdrant is up.
- `DELETE /api/cache/redis`: 200 even when the cache is disabled.

item.name: Upload document (POST)
item.description:
POST /api/documents (multipart/form-data)

Fields: file (required), source_id (required by the service), priority (P1, P2, ...; default P1), company_id, title, summary, metadata (JSON object string), tags (JSON array string or comma-separated), theme.

Each upload stores new chunks; uploading the same source_id twice keeps both copies. Use PUT or upsert to replace.
